Database.//: Postgres is the production target (README section 8). appsettings.Development.json overrides this with Sqlite so the site still runs locally without a database server installed.

ConnectionStrings.//DefaultConnection: Supplied out-of-band so no database credential is committed. Expected format: Host=localhost;Port=5432;Database=abc_construction;Username=postgres;Password=<password>. Locally: dotnet user-secrets set "ConnectionStrings:DefaultConnection" "<connection string>". In production: the ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection environment variable. Program.cs throws a named error if Database:Provider is Postgres and this is unset.

AdminSeed.//: Password is deliberately absent: this file is committed, so a literal password here would ship to anyone with repository access. Supply it out-of-band and no initial admin is created without it. Locally: dotnet user-secrets set "AdminSeed:Password" "<password>". In production: the AdminSeed__Password environment variable, or your host's secret store.

Localization.//: DefaultCulture is what first-time visitors see; returning visitors keep the language they picked in the header (stored in a cookie). The admin panel is always English.
